referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the production of 1 tons of hemp seeds, at farm respectively 7.5 tons of hemp straw (for 1 hectare cultivation), both with a moisture content of 15%.; UUID: 15a37765-e179-30c4-9256-6c8f951b530f
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the processes of soil cultivation, sowing, fertilisation, irrigation, straw and grain harvest, straw storage. The direct emissions on the field are included, as well as agricultural machinery dedicated to hemp cultivation. To be noted: hemp grows without pesticides as it is naturally resistant to pests. A big part of the fertilisation comes from organic fertilizers (liquid and solid manure). Emissions to air, water and soil have been taken into account accordingly.
referenceFunction.name: Hemp culture, hemp seeds

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from expert knowledge (agricultural cooperative in France), fertilising recommendations, retailers and statistics.
